title: Zero n-density of a locally finite weighted measure off its carrier (Upper Density Theorem)
statement: Let W ⊆ ℝ^Q be open, S ⊆ ℝ^Q Hⁿ-null-measurable, and g : ℝ^Q → [0, ∞] with ∫⁻_{S∩K} g dHⁿ < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ W. Then for Hⁿ-a.e. y with y ∈ W and y ∉ S: (∫⁻_{S ∩ B̄_ρ(y)} g dHⁿ) / ENNReal.ofReal(ρⁿ) → 0 in [0, ∞] as ρ → 0+.
lean_statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (W S : Set (Eucl Q)) (g : Eucl Q → ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen W → NullMeasurableSet S (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl Q), IsCompact K → K ⊆ W → ∫⁻ x in S ∩ K, g x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) < ∞) → ∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)), y ∈ W → y ∉ S → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (∫⁻ x in S ∩ closedBall y ρ, g x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))) / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
